title: J2 P003↔P007 removable compact flange — Gate04D-C2R1

design_intent.function: Provide a removable static-sealed P003↔P007 service boundary while preserving P007 containment can, 35 mm OAL and cartridge service access.
datum_functions: Ø14.10 H7/g6 pilot controls transverse location / coaxiality.
metal mating faces control axial location.
one clamp-hole axis provides angular clocking in verification; the three screws provide clamp, not redundant datum control.
O-ring provides sealing only; it is not the centering element.

selected_geometry.pilot: OD14.10 g6 ×1.50; C2R1 internal clearance ID12.00 STUDY

history_and_rejected_alternatives.reason: destroys required service access to P006/follower.
incompatible with actual P007 ID14.1 architecture.
insufficient outer ligament under previous M3 package.
worked geometrically but was unnecessarily bulky.
introduced exact 15.3966837 mm³ collision with P006 head.
retains compact flange and removes proven head/pilot collision with 0.25 mm nominal radial clearance.

mechanical_screen.screw_candidate: ISO 4762 M2.5×0.45, stainless A4-70 candidate; exact supplier/finish not frozen
interpretation: External pressure does not size the screws.
The preliminary thread screen does not reject M2.5.
This is not a release torque calculation.
Actual required preload is governed primarily by seal compression, joint separation margin, friction/galling and service conditions.

manufacturing_and_service.P003: Turn coaxial body/J2 zone and pilot/gland; drill/tap 3×M2.5 in 316L; deburr/passivate/clean; inspect pilot/gland/pattern/face.
manufacturing_and_service.P007: Deep-bore/finish thin can; retain Ø14.10 locator; machine OD33×3 flange within L35; drill 3×Ø2.90; inspect wall/ovality/runout/pattern.
advantages: three screws minimize holes and assembly operations
no permanent joining at service boundary
same 316L body/can minimizes thermal-expansion mismatch at the metal interface
open_service_items: P006 final service-tool feature/access through revised pilot ID

release_blockers: pilot/head production tolerance candidate H9/h9 defined; P006 face-drive feature and service torque/assembly method still OPEN
O-ring exact compound/hardness and process-gas compatibility
required clamp preload and released tightening method/torque
local head-bearing/flange bending and separation verification
P007 static and buckling refresh after mechanical freeze
production drawings and BOM metadata projection
current_decision: Keep C2R1 compact geometry as the active engineering candidate. Do not promote to stable until the release blockers above are closed.
